You don't need to know anything technical — just tell me your goal and I'll handle the rest. Clear pricing from the start, and you review a preview before deciding.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: A few common questions before starting a project.

items.title: How much does a website cost?
items.content: A one-page landing starts from 690,000₫, a multi-page website from 1,900,000₫, and a site with dynamic features (forms, login, admin, backend...) from 6,900,000₫. The final price depends on pages, features and complexity — I always confirm it clearly before starting, with no hidden fees.

items.title: You're a student — is the work reliable?
items.content: I'm a final-year software student taking on real projects to sharpen my skills. In exchange for the friendly price, you get a product built with modern tech and clean code, and I give it my all because it's part of my portfolio too. You're welcome to review demos and past work before deciding.

items.title: Can you build a site if I don't have a design?
items.content: Yes. Just describe your idea, your field or your goal. I'll advise on content structure, layout and the right approach.

items.title: Is the website SEO-optimized?
items.content: Yes. Sites are built with a search-friendly structure and support load-speed optimization, metadata, sitemap and the basic technical SEO factors.

items.title: Do you help with domain and hosting?
items.content: Yes. I can advise on or set up domain, hosting and related services if you don't have the infrastructure yet.

items.title: Is there support after handover?
items.content: Yes. After completion I still provide usage guidance, answer questions and handle bug fixes and small tweaks within the agreed scope.
